title: Transmembrane domain composition reflects subcellular localization of SNARE proteins
authors: Baumann C; Pulido-Quetglas C; Fasshauer D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SNARE蛋白跨膜域组成与亚细胞定位的适应性，结合统计与MD模拟，但对象为折叠跨膜蛋白而非无序蛋白/IDR，且不涉及PPI或互作机制建模，仅对膜环境适应有间接启发。
abstract: Transmembrane domains (TMDs) anchor proteins within membranes of distinct composition and biophysical properties, necessitating adaptation to each membrane's unique environment. SNARE proteins, the core mediators of eukaryotic membrane fusion, provide an ideal system to study such adaptations: they are ubiquitous across Eukaryota, with paralogs localized to different compartments that have evolved independently to match their membrane context. Here, we combine statistical analyses of approximately 14,000 SNARE TMDs with MD simulations of 28 human SNARE TMDs to uncover how TMDs have adapted to distinct membrane environments. We identify a clear compositional dichotomy that separates SNAREs of the early secretory pathway (ER and Golgi apparatus) from those of the late secretory and endosomal pathways: early TMDs are enriched in bulky Phe residues, whereas late TMDs are dominated by smaller Ile residues. The larger Phe side chains likely enhance hydrophobic interactions in loosely packed ER and Golgi membranes, while Ile likely prevents disruption of the tight lipid-lipid packing in the plasma and endosomal membranes, thereby contributing to protein localization. TMD lengths derived from MD simulations differ from those inferred by sequence-based approaches and show limited variations across compartments. Together, these results reveal how variations in membrane composition shaped SNARE TMDs across eukaryotic compartments.
abstract_zh: 跨膜结构域（TMDs）将蛋白质锚定在具有不同组成和生物物理特性的膜中，要求其适应每种膜独特的环境。SNARE蛋白作为真核生物膜融合的核心介导者，为研究此类适应提供了理想系统：它们在真核生物中普遍存在，其旁系同源物定位于不同区室，并独立进化以匹配各自的膜环境。在此，我们结合约14,000个SNARE TMDs的统计分析以及28个人类SNARE TMDs的分子动力学（MD）模拟，揭示TMDs如何适应不同的膜环境。我们识别出一个明确的组成二分法，将早期分泌途径（内质网和高尔基体）的SNAREs与晚期分泌及内体途径的SNAREs区分开来：早期TMDs富含庞大的苯丙氨酸残基，而晚期TMDs则以较小的异亮氨酸残基为主。较大的苯丙氨酸侧链可能增强松散堆积的内质网和高尔基体膜中的疏水相互作用，而异亮氨酸则可能防止质膜和内体膜中紧密脂质-脂质堆积的破坏，从而有助于蛋白质定位。从MD模拟中得出的TMD长度与基于序列方法推断的结果不同，且在各区室间显示出有限的变化。综合这些结果，揭示了膜组成的变化如何塑造了真核生物各区室中的SNARE TMDs。
